    highlight: tango  # specifies the syntax highlighting style

  isSlides: "no"

# Course title etc



The below section is the format for new slides:
--- 
#  Slide Title




The number of pound signs though will be important for dictating the size of your title and also for the hierachy of headings in your single page document. 

---
## My next slide

---
### My next slide, on a subtopic of prior slide





Images can be inserted using this path. Images from the parental img folder will be added to proximal directories to where these markdown fies are being compiled. Using a path similar to this will ensure they can find them. Compiling without the script may cause errors with this path though. This is not wrong. You just need to use the script.
